rules: the window: every figure from 1 January of settings.window_from; earlier rows are kept in the registers and never published here

a race is every calendar year after the election before it, up to and including its own, inside the window (ruling 361); 2017 is not a race (ruling 366); the 2020 race's named donors run from settings.named_from (ruling 363)
seven front-page parties (settings.headline_parties); other parties' data is kept and served, not worked
a renamed party is the same party: rows are joined on the registration key the lanes publish
a donation is from the donor the Commission filed it under; a wholly-owned company keeps its own row and ownership is a note, never added to the owner's total
if a return covers the money the return is the record; a disclosure of the same gift is shown beside it and never added
the headline is all donations, the return's declared total; named donors come second; one figure per party-year with its basis named
where our reading and the Commission's figure differ, the Commission's is the headline, linked to the Commission's own page
a person's home address is never shown or extractable: no payload carries one, and the address gate reads every payload's text
a suppressed name is suppressed on every surface; the row and the money stay
every figure names its document; a blank says 'none found' or 'not held'; a total states what it leaves out; an unreadable name is shown as unreadable; a figure read from pixels is marked weaker
a party-year with more than one return held and none replaced is shown with every return and none is chosen
known_limits: Nothing before 2017 (the queue asks whether 2019). Candidate returns are the candidate-returns lane's read returns alone: 380 current returns (2020: 211, 2022: 3, 2023: 166), of which 370 join a candidate in the official results; a candidate the lane holds no return for is 'not held', never a nil; the Commission's table rows the lane has not read as a return are not published, and 2017 is not held. Party boards have no lane, so board-member pages are 'not held'. Press, industry exposure, the interests tree and MPs' expenses are not in this template (the links have not read the expenses registers' names). The interests register is shown as the member's own returns under the shared reading of the printed name; real-property declarations are counted and their text withheld. Donations made by a person are joined only through a confirmed group of the links, and no group yet spans the house and donor registers, so the section is empty with its basis. Part A rows are read on 38 of the 152 returns held; a party-year whose rows are set aside shows its declared total and 'named rows not read'. Disclosures before 2023 have no scan held; their figures are the Commission's table alone. The 2020 and 2023 party lists are not held, so a list seat shows no list place and a list-only candidate who was not elected is not shown for those years. A financial statement the Commission lists is one line with every file of it under it, so a statement filed as two files is one line, not two.

settled.donor_picker: the rebuilt side's rule: every folded donor with money that counts in the window, from party returns, candidate returns and declarations in years no return covers, cut at settings.donor_list_cut after folding (today 633, none cut). Why: the frozen picker cut at 1,500 before folding and listed 1,345 of 2,152 with a hole on record; a cut after folding is the one the plan asked for, and a candidate's donor is a donor
settled.donor_display_name: the rebuilt side's rule: the spelling filed most often across the donor's rows, ties to the shorter then the alphabetical (figures.Donor.name); the row keeps its filed spelling. Why: the register's own most-used form, never a reading of ours; the frozen site chose a form by its own fold and titled it, so one donor sits at two paths until the switch, when old paths are mapped once. One display name is one donor and one page (site-3): a row the links have not read takes the links' reading of its exact filed spelling in any register, and donors left with one display name fold (figures.fold_by_display); the links' half is carded for them
settled.donor_page_key: the rebuilt side's rule: the display name above, so the path follows the fold. Why: the same rule as the frozen site under a different fold (the-two-folds-cut-donor-names-differently); ruling 253 keeps the EC-filed donor, so no owner's page absorbs a vehicle's rows. The key published beside the name (name_key) is that name's own form (paths.name_key) and no field repeats the links' reading, which carries whatever the filed cell carried when the links ran (hard limit 15; the name-keys gate holds it)
settled.person_page_key: the rebuilt side's rule: the name as the Commission's results print it (surname in capitals, 'Aaron STALLARD'). Why: the register's own form, not a title-casing of ours; the slug is the same on both sides, only the hash differs, and old paths are mapped once at the switch
settled.party_page_key: the registration key, one page per registration; two registrations with one name get two deterministic paths, the plain one to the key with most to show. Why: a set's order used to decide which survived (New Zealand Loyal, two registrations)
settled.declaration_year: the disclosures lane's rule (disclosures-3): a declaration belongs to the year of the gift (given_on), the Commission's date (received_on) only where no gift date is printed (2008-2022 declarations itemising several gifts); both dates are shown with the year's basis. Why: measured on all 520 held, 8 gifts were declared in a later year, and the frozen site buckets by the gift (15 of 16 party-years equal)
